encounter.title: Act I Encounter 3 — Square Candidate A (8x8 seed 231)
encounter.notes: LD-003 square shortlist candidate A for Act I #3. 8x8 seed 231 (13 arrows: N4 E4 S1 W4). Caster + escort dynamic. Caster N (hp 3, CAST IN 3 dmg 4, interruptible -> normal IN 3 dmg 2); Grunt E (hp 2, ATTACK IN 4 dmg 2). Perfect 5-tap sequence: tapping #1(E) and #0(E) kills the escort Grunt and unlocks #3(N) to interrupt the Caster exactly on turn 3 before the cast fires. Then #4(N) and #6(N) finish Caster with 0 damage. Failing to interrupt takes 4 massive damage.
